purpose: Original-source bibliography and claim checks for Chapter 1. This is not an exhaustive literature search or a claim that every cited paper was read in full.

writing_boundaries: No new metric, stable gain, completed external reproduction or significance result is asserted.
Swin is acknowledged to model context through its shifted-window hierarchy.
Soft membership and regional pooling use two distinct normalisations; feedback reuses membership weights.
The contribution is the implemented architecture and evaluation framework, not an assumed favourable result.
HGTNet and DFAGCN are an independent-reconstruction comparison track with unresolved implementation/protocol choices; they are not described as simply awaiting replies or as completed benchmarks.
No direct quotation of source abstracts is used; source-derived descriptions are brief and attributed.
The seven-chapter outline describes the intended complete thesis; it does not assert that Chapters 5-7 have been written.
